briefdescription.para: Edge object representing a connection between two vertices.

detaileddescription.para: Edges define the relationships and coupling between vertices in a network. Similar to vertices, edges contain their own state functions, local dynamics, and noise. They additionally facilitate delayed and directional information transfer between vertices, and are responsible for historical state storage of the vertices they join.

simplesect.para: Destroying an edge also destroys all historical states for the vertices it joins. Any channels used by the edge remain unaffected.
